data.rationale: The proposal gets the procedure right, with the steps in the correct order (Cars tab, location, dates and Done, times, Search, filter, sort), but it fixes drop-off to 'Same as pick-up' instead of making dropoff_location a parameter, and it leaves out a filters parameter, so the filter checkboxes it would apply are never named.
